_about: Suggested names for the ixitic atlas's unnamed shapes (ixoic_suggest.py), keyed by atlas name.

ixitic_region_23.why: Suggested from its ixoic twin 612fa060af7c (the same polychoron), suggested Phigypsobted (Phi Gyroprismatic Snub Bitetrahedral 240): the list names each ixoic snub bitetrahedral 240 that is also ixitic with a twin Dis120 (Sagypsobted / Sagypsobtady, Gypsobted / Gypsobtady, Awosbited / Awosbitdy, ...).

ixitic_region_16.why: Suggested from the ixitic list's own names: snub bitetrahedral for its 120 snits and snits; 7 unnamed shapes read this way, lettered Alpha, Beta, ... in the page's order, as the kidecaic series Abosid, Bebosid, Gabosid, .... Cells: irr. tets x3, phydows x2, snits x2, trigypos.
